metadata.title: WolrdPulse | Real-Time Telemetry & DevOps MCP Server
metadata.description: WolrdPulse is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server streaming live cloud outages (AWS, Vercel, GitHub), DNS DoH queries, and SSL certificate verification.

home.headline: Real-Time Cloud Telemetry for AI Agents
home.subHeadline: Stop AI hallucinations. Give Claude and Cursor instant access to global cloud outages, DNS resolution, and SSL verification via Model Context Protocol.

features.title: Live Cloud Telemetry Features
features.subtitle: Discover the powerful DevOps capabilities WolrdPulse exposes to AI coding agents.
features.faq1A: WolrdPulse is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides real-time DevOps telemetry to AI agents.
features.faq2Q: How do I connect Claude Desktop?
features.faq2A: Add npx wolrdpulse to your claude_desktop_config.json file to instantly equip Claude with live DevOps context.
